FN-W1SLK5E-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 317
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Curtis Travis
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/02/2026
House Bill 317 as introduced could increase receipts to Alabama Joint Fire Council by $1 for
each firefighter distinctive license plate issued to Fire Chaplains as provided by this bill.
Page 1
